> ⚠️ **This is a beta.** Every change passes the automated tests on Linux, macOS, Windows and Android, but this build hasn't been tested on real devices yet. Want the proven version? Stay on [v0.7.0](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync/releases/tag/v0.7.0). Found something odd? [Tell us](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync/issues/new).

**FluxSync copies on one device and pastes on another — over your own Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted, no account, no cloud.**

## What's new

### Files, up to 16 MB
Copy a file on a computer: it arrives in **Downloads/FluxSync** on the other one, already on the clipboard — just paste it into a folder. On Android, files land in Downloads/FluxSync, and you can **share any file to FluxSync**. (Both devices need this version.)

### Android: send without the Accessibility setting
- A **Send clipboard** button on the FluxSync notification.
- A **Send clipboard** tile for your quick settings.
- **Share → FluxSync** from any app, for text, images and files.

### Passwords stay private
- A password copied from a password manager (1Password, Bitwarden, KeePassXC…) still reaches your other device, but is **never kept in history or on disk**.
- A received password or key **disappears from the clipboard after 60 seconds**, unless you copied something else since.

### You choose how long history is kept
**1 hour, 1 day (default), 7 days or forever**, in Settings → Keep history. Pinned items always stay.

### See what arrived
Each copy shows **✓ and the name of the device** that received it.

### Simpler
- The battery saver is gone: FluxSync only sends when you copy, so pausing on low battery saved nothing and mostly caused "why did it stop?". Battery levels are still shown.
- History is no longer wiped when the other device has been away for 10 minutes.
- The firewall is now just **Always** or **Never** per type of content.
- Statistics and logs moved to a **Diagnostic** section.

## Download

| Device | File to download |
|---|---|
| **Android** (phone or tablet) | `FluxSync-v0.8.0-beta.2-arm64-v8a.apk` |
| **Mac with Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3…) | the `.zip` ending in `_aarch64.zip` |
| **Mac with Intel chip** | the `.zip` ending in `_x64.zip` |
| **Windows** (most PCs) | the file ending in `_x64-setup.exe` |
| **Windows on ARM** | the file ending in `_arm64-setup.exe` |
| **Linux** (Ubuntu, Debian…) | the `.deb` file |
| **Linux** (any distribution) | the `.AppImage` file |

The [README](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync#readme) walks through installing and pairing, step by step.

**Upgrading:** install over your current version; pairings and history are kept. An older device still syncs text and images with this one (files need both on this version).

## Good to know
- The apps aren't signed yet. On **Mac**, use `Install FluxSync.command` inside the zip. On **Windows**, click **More info → Run anyway** the first time.
- On Linux with X11 (not Wayland), password-manager copies are recognized by their content only.
- Files go directly between two devices running this version; they aren't passed on through a third device.
